narration.text: Most miss this: Noah saw dry ground and still waited. He stepped out when God said go. The One who shut the door opened it.
Two months more, until the earth was fully dry. Then, at last, the voice came. Not a shout. A word. And with it, the door that no one else could open.
And God spake unto Noah, saying,
And Noah went forth, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons’ wives with him:
Out they walked, a whole world of animals, one by one, down onto the washed new earth. Noah was the last of his family to step off the boat.
